analysis:
Documentation-only change in docs/reference/configuration.md. The head changes the last-updated date (line 3) and adds one row at head line 313 for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL. Per the row, exact `0` disables the setting and it defaults on. With it on, eligible full-attention prompt chunks take a single causal SDPA call on either KV backend, except live packed paged KV. With `0`, they use 128-query blocks. The setting is read once per process and is not forwarded to LaunchAgents.

The row describes a performance and dispatch choice in libs/mlx-swift-lm AttentionV1.swift. It does not touch any trust-model surface: attestation, keys, authorization, prefix-cache scoping or TTL, encryption, or the LaunchAgent passthrough allowlist. That means no new remote-controllable surface. Only the local operator, who is already adversarial under TB-003, can set it, and only for foreground processes.

Relevant threat IDs considered: TB-007, T-041 and T-007. On TB-007 and T-041, the changed prefill kernel could affect timing, but the T-041 TTFT oracle concerns cache hit versus miss and is unchanged in kind. On T-007, operators can already alter outputs. The doc claims nothing about qualification or security.

The implementation source is not supplied, so numerical equivalence and correctness of the fused path were not verified. That gap is a coverage limit, not a security regression. No findings.
